# file tools follow the same rules
# writes to temp folders are blocked
# reads outside the repo are allowed
# download, archive and build commands write where they are told
# git reset, switch, merge and pull write the repo they run in
# mktemp and git worktree are blocked
# wrappers and shell strings are followed
